description.value: The Studio & Stage Door is a city-owned heritage building dating to 1909, originally built by the local Masons as their Temple, and home to Cranbrook Community Theatre for over 50 years. The venue features an 83-seat theatre and a 1,050-square-foot hardwood dance floor, and has hosted everything from ballet classes to punk rock concerts and professional touring shows. Cranbrook Community Theatre has been producing theatrical works in the East Kootenays since the 1960s, making this a genuine cultural landmark for the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the venue is an active community theatre operating in a city-owned heritage building (built 1909) at 11 11th Ave S, Cranbrook, with phone 250-426-2490 matching the OSM record. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; the only accessibility tag is wheelchair=yes (StopGap ramp). The 2026/2027 season audition page confirms the business is actively operating.
concerns: OSM node name is 'Studio & Stage Door' (the building name) while the operating organization is 'Cranbrook Community Theatre'; both names are used on the website so this is not an error, but the directory listing should clarify the relationship.
No cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, making it impossible to confirm any required criteria.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, long-established cultural attraction (60+ years) in a historic 1909 heritage building; a legitimate stop-worthy destination for touring cyclists exploring Cranbrook's arts scene, though no cycling-specific amenities are confirmed.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wheelchair accessible via StopGap ramp per OSM tags; website does not elaborate further on accessibility.
